column1: # tests/memfn/pins/arms.tsv -- C5's per-arm pins ([MEMFN] R4c; integration.md
# §17.4): the sha256 of each scalar arm's rendering of each fixture site
# A CHANGE DETECTOR (§17.4 [rev4.2]): a kit change that moves an arm's text
# re-pins that arm's rows IN ITS OWN COMMIT, with its abi event (D76/D94: this
# file is a reader of the emitted text, found by grep). Recorded at R4c's
# IMPLEMENT commit, whose I1 shadow comparator proved the kit's rendering of
# every corpus compile equal to pcrec's pre-migration text. RE-PINNED at M1b's
# REPLACE (lane m1b): the fixtures' stand-in `run_cmp` hook is retired, so the
# run-bearing fixtures render the kit's own run compare and their word-load
# helpers (whose text M1b's I1 comparator proved equal to pcrec's over the
# corpus); the `runcmp` arm's fixtures are new. No artifact byte moved.
# m1bfix ADDED (no row re-pinned): ofs-miss-n (ofsskip, a miss stated as
# the `n` hook's text) and the two DECLINE fixtures ofs-decline-miss and
# ofs-decline-floor, pinned to `generic`: the offset-skip function returns
# `n` and reads from `pos` up, so a site with another miss or a stated floor
# is the generic row's. A row that falls back to ofsskip is check 1's red.
# missn ADDED (no row re-pinned): ofs-miss-token and pre-lead-handoff-miss-token,
# the sites of ofs-miss-n and pre-lead-handoff with `miss` stated by the
# MF_MISS_N token; each pins the SAME digests as its text-stated twin (the
# token renders as the `n` hook's text, never its own bytes).
# r4g ADDED (no row re-pinned): the PF find's fixtures (memfn/src/pffind.c,
# R4g/M2): pf-memchr, pf-memchr-bounded (form id pf_memchr), pf-walk,
# pf-walk-bounded (pf_walk), each with an EMPTY def part (the statement is
# the whole site), and pf-decline-not-in-place, pinned to `generic`: the walk
# is in place, so a site whose result is not its lo is the generic row's.
# Recorded at R4g's REPLACE commit; the four kit texts are the ones R4g's I1
# shadow comparator proved equal to pcrec's pre-migration text (IMPLEMENT
# commit, 7 PF shapes x their compiles, docs/dev/lanes/r4g_report.md).
# R4e'.0b RE-PINNED (lane r4e0b, 2026-10-09, D155 item 6, the routing; abi
# 68 -> 70): the ten `def` parts that hold an offset-skip function (six
# ofsskip, four precheck). Each function's loop moved, byte for byte, under
# `<fn>__body`, and `<fn>` became one call to it: 121 + 2 x len(<fn>) bytes
# per function (+139 for `rx_reqrun`), plus each table parameter declared
# once more and passed once (ofs-set-scan3, ofs-miss-*, ofs-run-pinned:
# `use` part and no other arm moved (arms2: 338/0).
# Columns (tab-separated): arm (the kit's form id), fixture, part (`def` the
# file-scope text, `use` the entry's), bytes, sha256.
# r4gfix ADDED (no row re-pinned; contract audit of the PF rows, memfn.h reads
# ret_pred / npred+preds on ALL_PRESENT and DENSE only): pf-memchr-ret-pred
# (a FIND memchr site stating ret_pred 2) and pf-walk-preds (a FIND walk site
# stating npred 1 + preds) stay pf_memchr / pf_walk, bytes equal to their
# unstated twins pf-memchr / pf-walk (finding 1). pf-emit-result-decl: mf_emit
# on the memchr site with result_decl "size_t " selects the generic row at
# selection (define|use gate), where it used to pick pf_memchr and be refused
# r4hprep ADDED (no row re-pinned; MF_SITE_ABI 5, Q-R4h-1 (a)): adv-kit-count
# and adv-caller-count, the scan edge's counted ADVANCE loop with its counter
# owned by the kit (declared as its first statement) and by the caller (never
# declared, only advanced and capped). The generic row renders both until M3
# (R4h); run_arm_pins.sh check 7 reads the declaration off each.
# advtarget (2026-10-08): R4h's FROZEN TARGET, one fixture per in-loop ADVANCE
# shape (STAY fwd/rev/view, EDGE unbounded and counted fwd/rev, VMSPAN with
# and without `it_`) with the hook texts pcrec writes today, its member text
# opaque. Each .use is ALSO committed verbatim as pins/r4h_target/<fixture>.c,
# compared byte for byte by run_arm_pins.sh check 8.
# M4 prep (R-7, MF_SITE_ABI 6): the reads-below FIND. pf-memchr-back is MLINE's
# site through its own row pf_memchr_back (form id pf_memchr): the memchr, `if
# (!q) break;` (LOOP_EXIT, Q-R7-3), the store + 1; empty AT_N (Q-R7-2), floor
# lo's text. find-back-reaches-n is a G2-style reads-below FIND the row does not
# take (empty MISS), rendered by generic with its read-bounded loop (Q-R7-1:
# M7 prep (R-8, MF_VOCAB 3, MF_SITE_ABI 7): the MISMATCH (F8), the encoding
# seam's span compare loop. mm-exact and mm-ucp-expr through the generic row
# mismatch_inplace (the ASCII fold of statements over `x`/`y`): the three
# shapes, each ALSO frozen as pins/n7_target/<fixture>.c (pcrec's pre-migration
# loop, run_arm_pins.sh check 10). mm-nonident (non-identifier hooks, a BRACED
# on_miss) and mm-inplace-clash (a hook naming `y`: the temps renamed) are the
# edges. Check 11 compiles and runs all five. No row re-pinned.
# M6 prep (R-10, MF_SITE_ABI 8): the STRIDED ADVANCE (Q-R10-2..5), the VM
# cursor rung's strided span loop: W SET terms, term i at offset i, every
# member pcrec's opaque class test of its position, ` && `-joined. Six shapes
# check 12); adv-vmstride-own has no member hook (the kit's own test of
# s[cursor + i], Q-R10-4). Check 13 runs -it, -lim and -own. No row re-pinned.
